title: php 2019 — 25 years of PHP
content:
PHP has been around for 25 years this fall and we will be celebrating this momentous landmark at the annual .php[world] conference

We have curated a for our attendees. There will also be a couple of amazing keynotes and two panels on the past and future of PHP and frameworks.special lineup of talks, workshops, and full-day training classes

It will be an amazing time, with some special events to help us all celebrate. and we look forward to seeing you this fall.Tickets are currently available

Washington, D.C. — October 23-24 — Training on October 22
author: PHP.net news & announcements
